method: Reviewed all18 regional route snapshots, shared bilingual source copy and specific implemented contact/analytics data flows. Changed only3 authorised UI page files, initially free of git diff. No server/analytics behavior changed, forms submitted, credentials read, remote media downloaded or new policy commitments invented. No substantive legal provision changed, so no new legal-source claim is made.
dataflowFindings: POST contact validates input and applies HMAC IP fingerprint rate limiting, then saves encrypted payload with request metadata.
AES256GCM encrypts submitted payload; Resend internal email includes message and attachments and is addressed to configured team and owner. Customer receives separate confirmation.
Both provider acceptances clear encrypted payload/IV/tag; metadata remains. Failed or exhausted notifications can retain encrypted content. No general mailbox/backups retention schedule established.

Analytics stores interaction counts and recent200events locally and pushes page_location with full browser URL, page title and event fields to Google Tag Manager. External container settings are outside repo evidence.
